episode_title: The Hidden Costs Draining Your Business

real_qa.q: What are the biggest hidden cost categories where companies typically overspend without realizing it?
real_qa.r: Insurance, shipping, and merchant card processing are among the top categories where organizations commonly overspend. Matt noted that insurance often involves embedded fees and auto-renewals that increase 5-7% annually without companies realizing prices have dropped in the market. Merchant card processing is described as a hidden area, particularly for retailers, where hundreds of thousands of dollars can be saved depending on volume.

real_qa.q: Why do most organizations miss vendor cost optimization opportunities despite having these contracts?
real_qa.r: The primary reason is lack of visibility and communication between departments. Companies often don't have centralized decision-making for vendor negotiations, with different departments handling their own contracts without knowing what others are paying. Additionally, automatic renewals cause costs to increase 5-7% annually while companies assume they have the best pricing, lacking the benchmarking data to know what market rates actually are.
real_qa.requete: why companies miss vendor cost savings

real_qa.q: Can standard vendor contract terms actually be negotiated or renegotiated during the renewal period?
real_qa.r: Yes, many contract terms are negotiable even when presented as standard. Matt explained that standard uniform contracts typically run three to five years, but companies can often negotiate better terms beforehand or find ways to renegotiate during the contract period. Having an advocate with benchmarking data and knowledge of what other companies have negotiated is essential, as most companies assume they must accept standard terms.

real_qa.q: What is ERA Group's scale and reach for obtaining benchmark pricing data across industries and geographies?
real_qa.r: ERA Group is the largest cost consultancy with 1,000 employees in 65 countries, giving them visibility into prices across the world and the ability to know the best pricing for any product or service in any geography. They also negotiate $60 million of insurance premiums at any given point in time, which provides significant buying power and leverage with vendors.
real_qa.requete: ERA Group cost consultancy scale countries employees

real_qa.q: How frequently should companies audit their vendor agreements and expense categories to find cost savings?
real_qa.r: Companies should conduct a review on an annual basis at minimum. Matt recommended taking the top 10 expense categories and auditing them annually, as automatic renewals typically increase 5-7% each year and companies miss opportunities by not regularly reviewing these costs. Setting up an audit committee with stakeholders from different functions helps identify a potential 5% of the budget that can be recovered through proper oversight.
